Previsão de aeródromo terminal

A concise statement of the expected meteorological conditions at an aerodrome for a specified period.

Why it matters

Questions and answers

What is Previsão de aeródromo terminal?

In this glossary, Previsão de aeródromo terminal refers to: A concise statement of the expected meteorological conditions at an aerodrome for a specified period.

How is Previsão de aeródromo terminal used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Piloto: Solicite o TAF para JFK para verificar se ventos cruzados são esperados durante minha aproximação."

Previsão de aeródromo terminal matters because it supports clear communication in Meteorology contexts for Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as ICAO Level 4, ICAO Level 5, ICAO Level 6, and EASA FCL.055.

Definition

A concise statement of the expected meteorological conditions at an aerodrome for a specified period.

Operational example

Pilot: Request TAF for JFK to verify if crosswinds expected during my approach.

Localized term

Previsão de aeródromo terminal

Localized example

Piloto: Solicite o TAF para JFK para verificar se ventos cruzados são esperados durante minha aproximação.
